title: Research Engineer / Research Scientist, Post-Training — Collective Alignment (User Signals)
desc:
About the Team

The Collective Alignment (User Signals) team is a post-training research team working at the intersection of data science, human feedback, and reinforcement learning. We develop methods for learning from real-world user interactions to build AI systems that deliver lasting value, helping people learn, grow, and accomplish increasingly complex goals with ChatGPT.

Learning from user feedback presents fundamental research challenges: signals are often noisy, biased, and difficult to interpret, and improvements in offline metrics do not always translate into better experiences for users. Our team develops scientific approaches to understanding these signals and translating them into improvements in model behavior through evaluations, reward modeling, and post-training.

About the Role

As a Research Engineer or Research Scientist, you will investigate how AI systems can learn from human feedback and real-world usage to better serve users over time.

You will develop new approaches to extracting meaningful learning signals from complex user interactions and incorporating those signals into model training.

This role requires strong deep learning research skills, scientific rigor, and curiosity about how people interact with AI. You will design controlled experiments and ablations, critically examine the relationship between offline evaluations and online model behavior, and work closely with research, product, and data science teams to understand whether improvements translate into meaningful value for users.

In this role, you will:

 - Develop novel methods for learning from human feedback and user interaction signals.

 - Research approaches to incorporating feedback into reward modeling, reinforcement learning, and post-training.

 - Design rigorous experiments and ablation studies to isolate the effects of new data, objectives, and training methods.

 - Develop offline evaluations and investigate their relationship with online experiments and real-world user outcomes.

 - Analyze unexpected results, investigate discrepancies between evaluation metrics and user behavior, and develop hypotheses to guide further research.

 - Evaluate tradeoffs and regressions to improve targeted model behaviors while preserving broader capabilities.

 - Collaborate with research, alignment, product, and data science teams.

 - Implement and debug experiments across large-scale deep learning research systems.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have a strong background in deep learning research through academic or industry experience.

 - Have demonstrated research ability through publications or substantive research contributions in deep learning or LLM post-training.

 - Have experience developing new machine learning methods and evaluating them through rigorous, hypothesis-driven experimentation.

 - Think critically about experimental design, measurement, and what evaluation results do and do not establish about model behavior.

 - Are comfortable designing ablations, investigating surprising results, and reasoning about the relationship between offline metrics and real-world outcomes.

 - Have strong programming skills and experience working with complex ML codebases.

 - Are curious about how people interact with AI and how those interactions can inform better models.

Nice to have:

 - Experience with RLHF, reinforcement learning, or modern LLM post-training.

 - Research or demonstrated interest in AI alignment, human feedback, or user signals.

 - Experience with online experimentation, evaluation methodology, or learning from noisy and biased feedback.

 - Experience connecting machine learning research with real-world product behavior.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
desc:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing Machine Learning & AI at Trainline 👋

Machine learning and AI are at the core of how Trainline is transforming travel, helping millions of customers make smarter, more sustainable journeys every day. Our ML models and AI solutions power critical aspects of our platform, including:

 - Advanced search and recommendations capabilities across our mobile and web applications

 - Pricing and routing optimisations to find the best fares for customers

 - Personalised user experiences enhanced by agentic AI

 - Data-driven digital marketing systems

Our machine learning teams own the complete delivery lifecycle from ideation to production. We work closely with stakeholders across the business to expand the understanding and impact of machine learning and AI throughout Trainline.

We are looking for Machine Learning Engineers to join our team help shape the future of train travel. You’ll be joining a high-performing, deeply technical community of Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, and Data Engineers to tackle complex problems by combining Trainline’s rich datasets with cutting edge algorithms. What unites our team is an expertise in the field, a love of what we do and the desire to create impactful solutions to support Trainline’s goals of encouraging sustainable travel.

As a part of Trainline you will be joining an environment where learning and development is top priority. You will have the opportunity to work with fellow ML & AI enthusiasts on large-scale production systems, delivering highly impactful products that make a difference to our millions of customers.



As a Machine Learning Engineer at Trainline you will... 🚄

 - Design and deliver machine learning models and/or AI solutions at scale that drive measurable impact for Trainline

 - Own the full end-to-end machine learning delivery lifecycle including data exploration, feature engineering, model selection and tuning, offline and online evaluation, deployments and maintenance

 - Partner with stakeholders to propose innovative data products that leverage Trainline’s extensive datasets and state of the art algorithms

 - Create the tools, frameworks and libraries that enables the acceleration of our ML & AI products delivery and improve our workflows

 - Take an active part in our AI and ML community and foster a culture of rigorous learning and experimentation

We'd love to hear from you if you...🔍

 - Have an advanced degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a similar quantitative discipline

 - Are proficient with Python, including open-source data libraries (e.g Pandas, Numpy, Scikit learn etc.)

 - Have experience productionising machine learning models and/or AI solutions

 - Are an expert in one of predictive modelling, classification, regression, optimisation, NLP algorithms or recommendation systems

 - Have experience with Spark

 - Have knowledge of DevOps technologies such as Docker and Terraform and ML Ops practices and platforms like ML Flow

 - Have experience with agile delivery methodologies and CI/CD processes and tools

 - Have a broad of understanding of data extraction, data manipulation and feature engineering techniques

 - Are familiar with statistical methodologies

 - Have great communication skills

Nice to have:

 - Experience with transport industry and/or geographical information systems (GIS)

 - Experience with cloud infrastructure

 - Experience with Large Language Models (fine tuning, RAG, agents)

 - Experience with graph technology and/or algorithms



More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do:

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

title: AI Applied Engineer – AI Engineer
desc: Join the most advanced community of AI makers. This role is in the ML & AI Applied Scientist archetype of the AI Applied Engineer chapter. Everyone in the chapter has the same title and the same foundation skills. Each person also has one main archetype, defined by the layer of the system they build, with skills specific to that archetype. Mission New models arrive every month, open or closed: you choose which ones are good enough for production, and you prove it. You build applications and agents on top of large language models (LLMs) and make the model part work. Our clients use these systems to answer customers, process documents and search their own knowledge. You decide what context the model gets, how it retrieves knowledge and which tools it can call. You measure how good its answers are, and choose the model that fits the cost and quality target. When an off-the-shelf model is not enough, you also build and adapt the models themselves: forecasting and optimisation engines, fine-tuned or distilled models, and the evaluation frameworks that prove a model is good enough. This role is for you if you want to know whether an AI system gives correct answers, not only whether it runs. Who you work with Product Engineers build the application around the model; you own how the model behaves inside it. Context & Analytics Engineers prepare the knowledge your agents retrieve, and Platform Engineers own the shared harness, runtime and model-serving infrastructure; you own the agent logic and behaviour that runs on it. With the AI Product Manager and the client's domain experts, you define what a good answer is and review results together. You review code with your peers and help newer colleagues. What you do Build machine learning applications, such as scoring or time series forecasting, with all the necessary steps: data wrangling, training loops, cross validation, evaluation, and deployment. Build LLM applications and agents: context design, tool calling, multi-step workflows. Design how agents use knowledge: retrieval queries, re-ranking, citations. Build evaluation sets and pipelines: reference answers, automated scoring, review by domain experts. Track answer quality in production and fix what degrades. Choose models by quality, cost and latency. Fine-tune or distil a smaller model when prompting is not enough. Add guardrails against wrong answers, data leaks and prompt injection. Process documents with LLMs: extraction, classification, summaries. Frame the modelling problem with the AI Product Manager and the business: the objective, the constraints and the metric that matters. Build forecasting and optimisation engines, and take them to production with Platform Engineers. Design evaluation frameworks and benchmarks for models and agents, including reinforcement learning where it helps. Run model research and benchmarking, and turn the results into reusable assets for the chapter. Explain model behaviour, uncertainty and limits to business stakeholders. Required Skills Must-haves: You have built an application or agent that calls an LLM, and you can explain where it worked and where it failed. You write tested, maintainable code. You already use coding agents in your daily work and check what they produce. You measure AI output quality with test sets and metrics, and you know how to limit made-up answers, prompt injection and data leaks. You know what it takes to put an LLM application in production and keep it there: deployment, monitoring, cost and latency. You start from the business problem, not the model, and you can explain to non-engineers when AI is not the right tool. You have a solid foundation in machine learning and statistics: you can explain why a model works and when it will fail. Bonus, not required: Fine-tuning or distillation of language models. Agent frameworks or protocols such as MCP. Multimodal inputs: documents, images, speech. LLM observability tools: tracing, cost tracking. Forecasting, optimisation or reinforcement learning in production. Publications, patents or open-source models. You don't need to tick every box to apply. If you match most must-haves and want to learn the rest, we want to hear from you. Tech grid skills that matter most: ML, Optimization & Foundation Models; Applied Math, Statistics & AI Evaluation; AI & Agentic Solutions. Certifications (a plus): Databricks Machine Learning Professional, Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer. Interview focus: Technical interview: maths, ML and LLM evaluation fundamentals. System design: go deep on the model or agent behaviour and how you evaluate it. Hands-on build: an LLM or ML component for the case and the evaluation that proves it works. Foundation skills, whatever your archetype Software craft: write code that is tested, reviewed and documented. Production ownership: own what you ship after launch, including monitoring, incidents and fixes. AI evaluation: define and run evaluations for AI features, and say when AI is not the right tool. AI system security basics: manage access rights and secrets, and guard against prompt injection. AI-assisted development: write the specification, delegate to coding agents, review the result and keep token costs under control. Product and business sense: build for users, ship a first version, measure adoption, improve it. Client relationship: explain your choices to clients and manage your part of the project. What we expect at your level Junior: builds features of their archetype with guidance, writes tested code and learns the client's context. What to expect / Recruitment process The process has five interviews. You don't need to choose an archetype before applying: after the HR interview, interviews 2 to 4 are run by engineers from the archetype that fits your experience, with a case from that archetype. Each archetype's interview focus is described in its section above. HR interview (45 min): your background and current situation, your fit (autonomy, client posture, teamwork) and your interest in building AI systems. Technical interview (60 min) with an engineer from your archetype: the fundamentals of your archetype (live coding for Product and Context & Analytics, cloud and DevOps for Platform, maths, ML and LLM evaluation for ML & AI Applied Scientists), then a deep dive on something you built. System design (60 min) with two engineers from different archetypes: design the AI system for a client use case, go deep on your part (application, platform, data and context, or model) and defend your choices. Hands-on build (60 min) with an engineer from your archetype: build a working piece of the previous case with the tools of your choice, AI coding assistants included, then demo it and walk through it. Fit interview (30 min) with a Director: meet the team and learn how we work. title: Machine Learning Researcher - Seismic Foundation Models
desc: Viridien ( www.viridiengroup.com ) is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges. Job details: The role Viridien, a leader in subsurface imaging, has been building seismic foundation models: models that learn representations of the subsurface from one of the largest, highest-quality proprietary seismic data in the industry, and that adapt to many downstream interpretation and imaging tasks with few labels or zero-shot. These models are primarily vision-oriented, treating seismic data as volumetric image data, and we are increasingly exploring multimodal extensions that incorporate additional data types such as well logs, velocity models and geological metadata. The central research challenge is not simply to train larger models, but to determine what the model learns, where it fails, and how to improve its ability to generalize across surveys, geological settings and downstream tasks. Rigorous understanding of what the model learns and where it generalizes is precisely how we earn a model reliable enough to trust on unseen surveys in production. You will work at the intersection of ML research and seismic imaging production, with access to that proprietary dataset and to substantial on-prem GPU capacity. You will own research hypotheses, model implementations and controlled experiments, working closely with geophysicists and geoscience specialists. No prior seismic expertise is required: our geoscientists will support you in building the domain knowledge you need. We welcome strong early-career researchers as well as more experienced ones, with or without a PhD.. Scientific rigor matters more to us than years of experience. What you do • Advance understanding of what a seismic foundation model learns, where it fails, and how to improve its generalization across surveys and geological settings. • Design, implement and improve model architecture, pre-training objectives and training-data strategies. • Establish generalization on independent seismic surveys against meaningful benchmarks and help define the evaluation protocol. • Diagnose model limitations and work with our ML engineers and geoscience specialists to improve reliability. Required • PhD (completed or near completion) in geophysics, applied mathematics, physics, computer science or a related quantitative field, or equivalent demonstrated research experience (e.g., a strong publication or open-source research record, or substantial research work in industry). • Demonstrated depth in computer vision, including vision transformers and self-supervised or representation learning for image or volumetric data, with the ability to justify training objectives and evaluation methods for scientific signal or image data. • Evidence of strong scientific problem-solving: forming testable hypotheses, designing controlled experiments, interpreting results critically, and learning from approaches that do not work. • Strong hands-on PyTorch skills: implementing, debugging and evaluating research models, with experience optimizing training for limited GPU memory and compute. • Ability to collaborate with geoscience specialists and to communicate technical assumptions and limitations clearly. Preferred (a plus, not required) • Experience with large-scale or distributed (multi-GPU / multi-node) training and the data pipelines it depends on. • Experience with multimodal learning or cross-modal representation alignment. • Prior exposure to seismic, geophysical or other scientific imaging data • Experience taking research models toward production or deployment. • Publications at strong machine-learning or scientific venues, or meaningful open-source contributions. • Familiarity with foundation-model pre-training at scale. What we offer • Access to one of the largest, highest-quality proprietary seismic datasets in the industry. • Substantial dedicated on-prem GPU capacity. • A genuine research mandate to turn advanced FWI imaging into actionable exploration insights and drilling prospects. Houston Benefits: 401k Retirement Plan - when you contribute up to 5%, not only will we match that, but we will also add an additional 2% Free on-site fitness centre offering group exercise classes Short-term disability and long-term disability coverage at no cost to you Parental Leave Program allowing mothers and fathers to take time off from work for childbirth, adoption and to bond with your new child Pet Insurance – options to meet every budget Wellness Program – resources provided to support your personal wellness and participation in activities can earn you $65 quarterly. Our Hiring Process At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience. Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. We do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond. We are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don’t hesitate to contact your recruiter directly. We see things differently. Diversity fuels our innovation, we value the unique ways in which we differ, and we are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

title: Research Engineer/Research Scientist-Post Training, Proactivity
desc:
About the Team

The Proactivity Research team, within OpenAI’s broader Post Training team, is focused on making our models in ChatGPT, Dots, and future potential products proactive in ways that are truly useful. We're laying the technical foundations for AI that can anticipate what users need in real time, adapt as their goals and preferences shift, and build a deeper, evolving understanding of the person it's helping.

About the Role

As a Research Engineer / Scientist, you will research and develop improvements to our models’ personalization and agentic capabilities. Our team works on reinforcement learning, dataset creation, evaluations, and other post-training methods. We partner closely with research and product teams across the company to realize the vision of a highly personalized, collaborative, and proactive assistant.

We're looking for individuals with strong ML engineering skills and research experience, especially with novel and highly capable models. An ideal candidate is passionate about product-driven research.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Own and pursue a research agenda to improve the proactivity and ability of our models to anticipate user needs and further their goals.

 - Build robust evaluations for tracking modeling improvements.

 - Design, implement, test, and debug code across our research stack.

 - Collaborate closely with the other research and product teams to influence the shape of technical solutions in the product

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have a deep understanding of machine learning and machine learning applications.

 - Have a working knowledge of LLM post-training and evaluation approaches

 - Are passionate about, or have experience thinking about, personalization and enabling users to achieve their goals

 - Are comfortable diving into a large ML codebase to debug.

 - Thrive in a dynamic and technically complex environment.





About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. title: Research Engineer / Research Scientist, Health
desc:
About the Team

The Health team, within OpenAI’s broader Post Training organization, has a mission to ensure AGI improves health for all humanity.

Improving human health will be one of the defining impacts of AGI. Hundreds of millions of people already turn to ChatGPT for questions about their health and millions of clinicians use it weekly to support care delivery. Increasingly capable models create an opportunity to make high-quality medical intelligence more accessible across patients and clinicians—raising the floor of human health—and accelerate the new capabilities and scientific advances that raise the ceiling of human health.

Our job is to make those benefits real. We work across the full model stack—pretraining, midtraining, reinforcement learning, post-training, evaluations, harnessing, and deployment—and connect that research to the patients, clinicians, and real-world outcomes we aim to improve.

About the Role

We’re looking for an exceptional, hands-on researcher who wants to build frontier health capabilities and turn them into impact at scale. This is a role for someone who can take an important, underdefined problem from 0→1: identify the right bet, build what’s needed to test it, and drive it all the way to a measurable improvement in the models and products we actually ship.

We’re especially excited about two kinds of people: researchers with the technical depth to move the frontier in pretraining, reinforcement learning (RL) / post-training, or evals; and researchers with real depth in developing frontier biomedical AI capabilities. Prior experience in healthcare is helpful but not required. Research excellence, velocity, ownership, and alignment with the mission are most important to us.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Own a high-leverage research direction end to end—from deciding which problem matters and how to measure it, to designing and running experiments, to integrating successful work into frontier models.

 - Develop scalable methods across pretraining, midtraining, reinforcement learning, and post-training to improve health reasoning, knowledge, reliability, calibration, and behavior.

 - Build and study RL environments grounded in real health problems; understand which data and training setups produce robust, generalizable improvements rather than just higher benchmark scores.

 - Create meaningful, trustworthy, and unsaturated evaluations that tell us whether our models are actually getting better at what matters for patients and clinicians.

 - Advance new 0→1 capabilities in health that may have an increasing impact with upcoming increases in model intelligence and test-time compute.

 - Develop models and agents that can work over longitudinal, multimodal health data to produce useful predictions, surface new scientific insights, and support better individual- and population-level decisions.

 - Work closely with researchers, engineers, clinicians, and product teams to bring health capabilities into the models and products used by hundreds of millions of people.

 - Help establish that AI improves real health outcomes, not just that it can produce impressive answers or demos.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Care deeply about using increasingly capable AI to improve human health, and take seriously the responsibility of deploying it safely.

 - Have an unusually strong track record in machine learning or AI research, with the depth to push at least one important area forward: pretraining, reinforcement learning / post-training, evals (not necessarily specific to health); or substantial depth in a relevant frontier health / biomedical AI problem.

 - Are a hands-on builder: you can design experiments, write and debug code, work directly with data and training infrastructure, and move quickly from an idea to evidence.

 - Have strong research taste and can distinguish an important problem or a promising approach from an interesting one.

 - Own ambiguous problems end to end, and are willing to learn whatever is missing to get the job done.

 - Stay goal-oriented rather than method-oriented, and don’t shy away from unglamorous work if it is the highest-leverage path to impact.

 - Care about whether a capability will scale, generalize, and make it into the real world—not just whether it can be shown in a paper or prototype.

 - Enjoy working with low-ego, ambitious people across research, engineering, medicine, and product.

 - Bonus: Experience with health AI, longitudinal health data, or clinical research.

 

If you want your work to help make medical intelligence widely accessible—and to work on some of the most important frontier problems at the intersection of AI, science, and human health—we’d love to hear from you.

title: Research Engineer/Research Scientist- Post Training, Model Experience
desc:
About the Team

The Post Training team is responsible for training and improving pre-trained models to be deployed into ChatGPT, the API, and potential future products. In the Model Experience team, we shape the default character and behavior of ChatGPT: how the model communicates, responds to users, uses its capabilities, and behaves across different contexts and languages. Our goal is to make every interaction with ChatGPT thoughtful, helpful, and trustworthy. We take an opinionated view of what good human–AI interaction should look like, then turn that vision into real model behavior through human data, evaluations, reward models, and post-training.

Our work sits at the intersection of research, product, and model design. We partner closely with teams across OpenAI to conduct research and ensure our models are thoughtful, safe, reliable to serve millions of users.

About the Role

As a Research Engineer / Scientist, you will research and develop improvements to our models. Our team works in research areas combining reinforcement learning and products.

We're looking for individuals with strong ML engineering skills and research experience, especially with novel and highly capable models. An ideal candidate is passionate about product-driven research and the quality of human-AI interaction.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Own and pursue a research agenda to improve model capability and performance.

 - Collaborate closely with the other research and product teams, allowing customers to optimize their own models.

 - Build robust evaluations for tracking modeling improvements.

 - Design, implement, test, and debug code across our research stack.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have a deep understanding of machine learning and machine learning applications.

 - Have good judgment about model behavior and can communicate this judgment effectively.

 - Enjoy taking ambitious, qualitative problems and turning them into concrete training interventions.

 - Have a working knowledge of relevant models, and building evaluations for model capability improvement.

 - Are comfortable diving into a large ML codebase to debug.

 - Thrive in a dynamic, technically complex, and collaborative environment.

title: Stage - Développement de modèles d'AI/ML appliqués aux échangeurs à plaques et ailettes brasées en aluminium H/F
desc: Chez Alfa Laval Golbey, nous concevons et fabriquons des échangeurs thermiques de haute technologie utilisés dans les secteurs de l’énergie, du GNL et des industries de process. Notre savoir-faire reconnu en cryogénie nous permet d’accompagner des projets industriels majeurs à l’échelle internationale. Rejoindre notre site de Golbey, c’est intégrer un environnement industriel stimulant, au sein d’un groupe international innovant, engagé dans la performance durable et la transition énergétique. Quel est le poste ? Dans le cadre de la modernisation de sa méthode de dimensionnement des échangeurs à plaques et ailettes brasées en aluminium, Alfa Laval Golbey souhaite évaluer l’apport de méthodes de type Intelligence Artificielle / Machine Learning. Dans ce cadre, une première étape consistant à construire une base de données a d’ores et déjà été réalisée. Cette base de données contient la description des équipements à la fois d’un point de vue géométrique, mais aussi du point de vue des conditions de fonctionnement. Nous recherchons un stagiaire R&D (H/F) pour poursuivre cette démarche. Vos missions seront de : Identifier les variables les plus explicatives pour prédire les caractéristiques géométriques des équipements Entrainer, sur la base de données existante, plusieurs modèles visant à prédire certaines caractéristiques géométriques des échangeurs lors de la phase de design de l’équipement Adapter et compléter la base de données pour améliorer la prédiction des modèles, que ce soit par l’ajout de nouvelles variables dans la base de données ou par l’estimation de nouvelles variables à partir de celles déjà disponibles (nombres adimensionnels, …) Ce stage permettra donc d’identifier clairement les apports et limites de telles méthodes, mais également celles associées à la base de données actuellement disponible. Ce travail contribuera au développement d’une nouvelle approche de dimensionnement des échangeurs de chaleur à plaques et ailettes brasées s’appuyant, d’une part, sur des approches physiques et, d’autre part, sur une approche « data » pour améliorer et accélérer le processus de conception en identifiant plus rapidement une géométrie adéquate. Une compréhension de l’approche physique et des échanges réguliers au sein de l’équipe permettront de conduire en parallèle ces deux axes de développement. Qui êtes-vous ? Que connaissez-vous ? Actuellement en Master 2, Ecole d’ingénieur ou équivalent, vous avez une orientation sur l’analyse de données, ou le Machine Learning. Des notions de thermiques et de mécanique des fluides seraient un peu plus pour mieux appréhender le fonctionnement de l’équipement et les relations entre les différentes informations stockées dans la base de données. Vous avez également une forte sensibilisation à l’Intelligence Artificielle, aux outils de Machine Learning et à Python. Votre capacité de communication et votre curiosité vous permettront de mener à bien cette mission. Durée du stage : 6 mois à partir de février ou mars 2027 Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Nous offrons un poste stimulant dans un environnement ouvert et convivial où nous nous aidons mutuellement à nous développer et à créer de la valeur. Votre travail aura un véritable impact sur le succès futur d’Alfa Laval. En nous rejoignant, vous intégrerez un groupe international qui vous donnera accès à de multiples opportunités d’évolution et de mobilité, et ce, dans de nombreux domaines professionnels, notamment grâce à nos programmes d’intégration et d’accompagnement, mais également sur le plan personnel. En effet, vous pourrez bénéficier d’un mode de travail hybride et de nombreux autres avantages mutuelle, restaurant d’entreprise, CE, accord d’intéressement et de participation, etc.
